# CTR Infrastructure

> CTR Infrastructure is an architecture and infrastructure design practice serving projects across Tamil Nadu and Karnataka, India.

## Official pages

- [Home](https://ctrinfrastructure.com/): Overview, services, and contact details.
- [Services](https://ctrinfrastructure.com/#services): Architecture, planning, and infrastructure services.
- [Project portfolio](https://ctrinfrastructure.com/projects/): Published project case studies.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://ctrinfrastructure.com/faq/): Service coverage, project timelines, and enquiry information.
- [Contact](https://ctrinfrastructure.com/#contact): Enquiry form, telephone, email, and office locations.
- [Privacy policy](https://ctrinfrastructure.com/privacy/): Website privacy information.

## Areas of work

- Architecture and building design
- Infrastructure engineering
- Urban planning
- Commercial, residential, institutional, hospitality, and infrastructure projects
